rules.description: The main paper is at most 8 pages; references, the impact statement, appendices and acknowledgements do not count. Source: https://icml.cc/Conferences/2025/CallForPapers and https://media.icml.cc/Conferences/ICML2025/Styles/icml2025.zip (example_paper.tex)
The paper body is set in 10 point Times with 11 point spacing. Source: https://media.icml.cc/Conferences/ICML2025/Styles/icml2025.zip (example_paper.tex)

Pages are US Letter (the style file sets 8.5 x 11 in; the template requires US Letter for final versions). Source: https://media.icml.cc/Conferences/ICML2025/Styles/icml2025.zip (icml2025.sty, example_paper.tex)
The paper includes an Impact Statement section at the end, before the references. Source: https://icml.cc/Conferences/2025/CallForPapers
Acknowledgements are not included in the version submitted for blind review. Source: https://media.icml.cc/Conferences/ICML2025/Styles/icml2025.zip (example_paper.tex)
Review is double-blind: the submission must not identify its authors. Source: https://icml.cc/Conferences/2025/CallForPapers
